text:
Anya: propose we narrow next sprint: ship eval-triggered alerts (preview + canary) and a rule-based quantization advisor. Defer adaptive batching and cache heuristics. Quick reactions? :thought_balloon:

Tom: +1. Keep API tiny. Need firing rules, dedupe, and dry_run.

Raf: SRE asks: event schema, retention defaults, and a simple circuit-breaker if alerts spike. Propose retention 90d for raw alerts, 365d for aggregates.

Lena: CS note  HealthCo will canary if we provide dry_run preview + CS webhook and per-model thresholds.

Anya: draft ACs:
1) Alerts emitted within 60s of eval completion for flagged orgs.
2) Config: per-org/per-model thresholds via API/Console.
3) Payload: model id/version, eval_run id, metric deltas, top 5 failing example ids, link to report.
4) Noise control: dedupe window default 10m, per-org cap default 5/hr, circuit-breaker >300/day.
5) Dry_run: preview mode records alerts without external notification; CS webhook still receives preview.
6) Quant recs: rule-based advisor outputting expected p99 delta, throughput uplift, token-cost estimate, and short risk note; advisory only.

Tom: will scope minimal endpoints and Console preview card. Raf: will draft schema + ops playbook. Lena: will onboard HealthCo and schedule pre-notify.

feature-bot: feature flag created: optimize_eval_mvp (id: ff-1848) :white_check_mark:

Anya: thanks all  PM will add tickets with ACs and move batching/cache to Backlog. :thumbsup:
